about: Default rule set for a cmd-hub fleet. Edit in the Rules tab or by hand; ids must stay unique.
claudeMdHead: # Fleet-wide rules (managed, read by every agent)

rules.title: Coordinate through the hub
rules.desc: Agents talk to each other only through cmd, so every message is on the map.

claudeMd.text: - Coordinate only through the cmd hub: `cmd tree` shows the fleet, `cmd send <id> "..."` reaches another agent, `cmd done "..."` closes the task you are on.

rules.title: Report results, not "done"
rules.desc: A finished task says what changed, where, and how it was checked.

claudeMd.text: - Report results, not "done": say what changed, where (file, commit, URL) and how you checked it.

prompt.text: When you finish, report the result: what changed, where (file, commit, URL) and how you verified it. "Done" alone is not a report.

rules.title: Ask a person for decisions
rules.desc: Decisions that belong to a person go to them as a card, not a guess.

claudeMd.text: - Decisions that belong to a person (spending, deleting, publishing, anything hard to undo) go to them with `cmd ask`; do not guess and do not wait silently.

rules.title: Nothing is deleted without asking
rules.desc: Outside its own scratch directory an agent asks before deleting and archives instead.
rules.risk: Agents may delete files, data or history without asking; there may be no way back.

claudeMd.text: - Never delete anything outside your own scratch directory without asking first (`cmd ask`); move it to an archive instead of removing it.

prompt.text: Never delete files, data, mail or git history outside your scratch directory without a person's OK; archive instead.

rules.title: Back up, then verify
rules.desc: Every change is backed up first and checked afterwards; a broken change is rolled back.
rules.risk: Changes are made without a backup or a check; a broken change may not be recoverable.

prompt.text: Before every change: back up what you change, verify it works afterwards, and roll back at once if it broke.

rules.title: Git hygiene
rules.desc: Never commit secrets; small commits with clear messages; no rewriting shared history.
rules.risk: Secrets may end up in a repository, or shared history may be rewritten.

claudeMd.text: - Git hygiene: never commit secrets (keys, tokens, passwords, .env files); keep commits small with a clear message; never rewrite shared history.

rules.title: Heavy jobs through the queue
rules.desc: Builds, test suites and big scans run through heavy so the machine stays responsive.

claudeMd.text: - Run heavy jobs (builds, full test suites, large scans) through `heavy -- <command>` so the hub can queue them and keep the machine responsive.

rules.title: Context care
rules.desc: Keep the context small and compact once a turn ends above the threshold.

prompt.text: Context care: summarise long tool output instead of pasting it, and run /compact once a turn ends above {{compactK}}K.

rules.title: Quiet hours
rules.desc: When quiet hours are configured, the hub parks background loops in that window.
